title: Layer 2, Multichain, and Cross-Chain Development
learning_outcomes: Explain the main ideas in Layer 2, Multichain, and Cross-Chain Development and correctly use the key terms in context.
Build or inspect a minimal Solidity example that demonstrates the lesson concepts.
Test representative failure cases and describe version, security, or operational assumptions where relevant.

overview_visual.alt_text: A two-column ordered roadmap for Module 20: Layer 2, Multichain, and Cross-Chain Development; it lists all 12 source-syllabus lesson topics by number.
overview_visual.caption: Module 20 roadmap: EVM Compatibility and Network Differences; Layer 2 Scaling Fundamentals; Rollups and Execution Environments; Deploying Contracts on EVM-Compatible Networks; Differences in Gas Pricing and Execution Assumptions; Cross-Chain Messaging Concepts; Bridges and Cross-Chain Trust Assumptions; Message Verification and Replay Protection; Cross-Chain Finality and Failure Handling; Multichain Deployment Configuration; Chain-Specific Testing and Compatibility; Cross-Chain Security Reviews. Work through the topics in order, then implement a small example and verify assumptions.
